report_reference_count_semantics: Number of historical AgentRead Markdown files with a literal normalized exact entry path; at most two example paths included per entry. This is navigation/reference counting, not proof of a critical evidence dependency.
membership_digest_format: SHA256 of UTF-8 ordinal-sorted repository-relative path|size_bytes|LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks joined by LF, no trailing LF
top_50_directory_size_semantics: Sum of candidate files below directory, not the size of all unrelated source/assets below an ancestor; directory rows overlap and must not be summed.
no_delete_assertion: No deletion, movement, compression, cleanup execution, git write, simulation, Python import, or checkpoint loading occurred.
